note: Case reports of SGSM3-related disorder document delayed speech in early childhood followed by spoken, albeit unclear, language in adulthood.

evidence.text: Affected individuals with homozygous SGSM3 mutations presented with delayed speech in childhood but possessed speech capability into adulthood (described as unclear speech).

source.title: Intellectual disability syndrome associated with a homozygous founder variant in SGSM3 in Ashkenazi Jews
source.quote: and had developmental delay. As an adult, he was unable to read and had unclear speech. He … The third affected child had normal motor development yet delayed speech.
